notes: Definitions: PackCurrent = net battery current; BatteryCurrent (MC) = current going to the motor, as measured by the motor controller (proprietary). Berkeley logs no motor-controller current, so estimate it at the HV bus: motor current = battery discharge + array current into the bus. Ignores auxiliary HV loads and MPPT losses (both small). Needed by sunbeam MotorPower -> Efficiency. Ours is unsigned (0-57 A) with direction in BatteryCurrentDirection.
Sunbeam MotorPower: direction 1 = negative current (regen), 0 = driving.
